data.exact_reserve_text: The gross claims development triangle shows the following changes in ultimate estimates for prior underwriting years (2018-2020) as of 31 December 2022 compared to the previous year's ultimate estimates: 2018: -GBP 27.888m, 2019: -GBP 14.729m, 2020: -GBP 20.816m, resulting in a total gross release of GBP 63.433m.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1975 reported a significant gross reserve release of GBP 63.433m for prior underwriting years (2018-2020). This favorable development is indicated by the gross claims development triangle. The syndicate also entered into a 100% Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) and 100% Group Quota Share (QS) transaction with its Parent Company, MPMIC, which reinsures loss reserves on 2022 and prior years of account, eliminating uncertainty within gross technical provisions and likely influencing the reserve review.
raw_causal_phrases: The uncertainty within gross technical provisions is eliminated (apart from any bad debt consideration) by the LPT and QS contracts, reinsuring the balances to MPMIC.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development calculated from the gross claims development triangle by comparing current ultimate estimates to previous year's ultimate estimates for underwriting years 2020 and prior.
